meta.note: Best-value houses across the inner-Perth ring (every residential suburb within 15km of the CBD, north, east, south and west). Brief unchanged: houses, 3+ beds, up to $1.1M, land favoured. meta.value_note: A discount is measured against the median ask of comparable listings on the market now in that suburb, not against a suburb median and not against a valuation. Listings with no published price are never treated as cheap. General information, not advice.
